content.p1: Selling is easy, yet there are a few things that must be set in order to be able to sell. Firstly, you must save your trade link and your Steam API key in ‘Steam Account’ section of your WaxPeer user profile.
content.p2: After completing the profile settings and starting sales, you need to go to the ‘Sell items‘ section. If you already have the ‘Waxpeer Extension‘ installed, then make sure that you are in the ‘Online‘ status. If everything is successful, then in this case you will see ‘Sales available‘ on the left side of the page. If you do not have an extension, you must download either our extension or application, so that we can automate the trades.
content.p3: Once either extension or application is ready to be used, it will look like one of the pictures shown. (If your extension has the status ‘Please log in to Steam’, this means you must be logged in to Steam on both steamcommunity.com and steampowered.com on your browser) and once your ‘P2P Status’ is online (green), you can begin selling by choosing a skin, putting a price for it and listing it.
content.p4: Now you can select the items you want to sell.
content.p5: While putting the price for your listing, you can use the upper buttons to easily put a good price that suits you.
content.p6: All your items for sale will be located in the 'Sell offers' section. In this section, you can monitor the status of your offer, change its price, or delete the offer.
content.p7: Once someone decides to purchase one of your listed items, you will receive a notification on-site. If you wish to, you can as well connect your Discord or/and Telegram through your account settings to WaxPeer in order to also get notified there apart from website itself.
content.p8: You are required to confirm the trade that was sent by us via your account once someone purchases your item on sale. The confirmation appears on Steam mobile app, ‘Confirmations’ section. Once you confirm it, the item is sent. As soon as the buyer accepts the trade offer with the item, your WaxPeer account gets credited.
content.p9: Keep in mind that you can only sell items that are tradeable.
